text: Aura damage x2.2. Kittens deal no damage.
godot: Works alone. The aura more than doubles and the kittens stop dealing damage entirely.

text: +1 card in every hand. Damage x0.8.
godot: Turns up with a clipboard. One more card in every hand, and every card taken arrives a level higher, for a fifth of your damage.
note: Godot's tree text also says every card arrives a level higher: the job has no such effect (that is Prototype). Finding F45.

text: Damage x1.1. Catnip x1.1. No downside.
godot: Declined every position. Ten percent more of everything, and it costs nothing at all.

text: Catnip x1.8. Damage x0.7.
godot: Takes what is not nailed down. Far more Catnip from everything, and you hit a good deal softer for it.

text: Crit chance +10%, then x3. Crit damage x2.5. Attack speed x0.5.
godot: Strikes rarely and enormously. Three times the crit chance, crits two and a half times as hard, and swung at half the speed.
note: +10% is added before the x3 (game_state.gd get_job_crit_chance_bonus).

text: Catnip x2.5. Kitten damage x0.4.
godot: Everything is owed to you. Two and a half times the Catnip, and the kittens barely scratch.

text: Spawn rate x2. Enemy health x1.6.
godot: Calls them in. Twice as many arrive, and every one of them is half again as hard to put down.

text: Increases damage. +15% to +130% and x1.06 to x1.75 over 10 levels.
godot: Adds to your damage and multiplies it — paw and aura alike. Two brackets in one node: the flat bonus sums with itself, the multiplier rides on top.

text: Increases kitten damage. +35% to +350% over 10 levels.
godot: Adds to every kitten's damage. Scales with how many kittens you own, so it pairs with Vitality.

text: Adds kittens. They attack enemies on their own. +1 to +10 over 10 levels.
godot: More kittens, permanently. They hunt on their own and keep earning while you aim elsewhere.

text: Unlocks the aura: it damages every enemy inside its radius. Unlocks the Aura Radius upgrade.
godot: Gives you the AURA: everything inside your reach takes continuous damage, instead of one mouse at a time. Its Aura Radius shop line appears once you own it.

text: Increases aura damage. x1.18 to x3 over 10 levels.
godot: Makes the aura hurt more. Needs the Aura.

text: Increases aura radius permanently. x1.08 to x2 over 10 levels.
godot: Permanently widens the aura. The shop line does the same thing for one run; this one keeps it.

text: Unlocks Pounce ({pounce}): 2s of your damage at once. x5 on an enemy whose shield is down.
godot: Teaches you to POUNCE — a burst on {pounce}, worth more if you time it into a vulnerable window. Its two shop lines appear once you own it.
note: x5 = pounce_vulnerable_multiplier, on enemies with a shield cycle whose shield is down.

text: Increases Pounce damage. x1.18 to x2.9 over 10 levels.
godot: Makes each Pounce hit harder. Needs Pounce.

text: Pounce fires automatically when ready, at x1.1 damage. It gets no x5 shield bonus.
godot: Pounce fires itself the moment it is ready, and you earn more while the game is shut. The auto-fired burst is worth less than one you timed yourself — that is the trade.
note: Godot's text promises more earnings while the game is shut: offline earnings were removed 2026-09-10. Finding F44.

text: Unlocks overkill: damage past a kill. 2% of it hits the nearest enemy.
godot: Damage past a mouse's last hit point splashes onto the nearest survivor instead of evaporating.

text: Increases the overkill that hits the nearest enemy. +4.5% to +28% over 10 levels.
godot: Raises the share that splashes. Needs Overkill.

text: The cat rides the Unicorn. Unlocks the Unicorn skills.
godot: The cat rides a unicorn now, as is its right. Opens everything the Unicorn can be made to do.

text: Unlocks Rainbow Poop: every 8s, a puddle that damages enemies for 3s.
godot: Unlocks Rainbow Poop. It is exactly as unpleasant as it sounds and it kills things.

text: Increases Rainbow Poop damage. x1.3 to x4 over 10 levels.
godot: Multiplies Rainbow Poop's damage. Needs Rainbow Poop.

text: Increases Catnip per kill and Golden enemies. Catnip x1.038 to x1.268, Golden chance +0.5% to +5%.
godot: Every mouse is worth more Catnip, and Golden Mice turn up more often. It does not make you kill faster — it makes the killing pay.

text: Each run starts ahead. Keep 5% to 50% of your Catnip. Upgrades start at Lv 2 to 26, in biome 2 to 6.
godot: The next run starts further along: you keep a share of your Catnip, your shop lines start already levelled, and you open in a deeper biome. Only ever as deep as you have already earned.
note: Biome 2 to 6, never deeper than you have reached.

text: Ground enemies move 40% slower everywhere. Fliers are not slowed.
godot: Everything on the ground moves like it is wading. Not just inside your reach — the whole floor is yours. Fliers do not care.

text: Increases the Snare slow. 44% to 80% over 10 levels.
godot: The wading gets worse. At the last rung a mouse on the ground barely moves at all.

text: An enemy about to escape turns back. 1 to 3 times per enemy over 10 levels.
godot: A mouse about to wander off the edge is turned back instead. Roughly a third of everything that spawns currently leaves without paying you.

text: Enemies killed below 20% health give more Catnip. x1.1 to x2 over 10 levels.
godot: A mouse you finish off while it is already nearly dead pays more. Bat it around first.

text: The Unicorn fires a beam at the nearest enemy. It deals 35% of your aura damage.
godot: The horn fires a continuous beam at whatever is nearest. It is a share of your AURA, so every point you have ever put into the aura is already in it.

text: A beam kill jumps to the next enemy. 1 to 5 jumps over 10 levels.
godot: When the beam kills something it jumps to the next thing. And the next.

text: Beam kills give more Catnip. x1.15 to x2.5 over 10 levels.
godot: Anything the beam finishes off pays more. The only thing in the game that makes you want a mouse to stay alive one more second.

text: The beam sweeps and damages every enemy it crosses.
godot: The beam stops picking targets and simply sweeps, hitting everything it crosses.

text: Beam kills drop shards. Every 10 shards: 50% to 320% of aura damage to all enemies.
godot: Beam kills leave shards. Enough shards and the whole screen goes off at once.

text: Increases Shred per stack. +0.5% to +5% over 10 levels. Doubles the Shred upgrade's cap.
godot: Every hit leaves a dent, and dents stack. Doubles the ceiling the shop's own Shred line stops at.

text: Start each run with extra rerolls. +1 to +5 over 5 levels.
godot: You are still here. Every run starts with rerolls in hand - the one part of the card economy no shop line sells.

text: Increases damage for each Reawaken done. +1% to +5% per Reawaken over 10 levels.
godot: They owe you for every life you have already given them. Damage rises with every Reawaken on the save.

text: Increases damage to snared enemies. x1.1 to x2 over 10 levels.
godot: The floor is the weapon. Anything wading through your Snare takes far more from everything you have.

text: Each new wave pays interest on your Catnip. +0.2% to +2% over 10 levels.
godot: Catnip you have not spent works for you. A share of the bank is paid back every time the wave turns over.

text: Each kill shortens the Pounce lock. -0.05s to -0.5s per kill over 10 levels.
godot: The Cone of Shame is a countdown, not a sentence. Every kill you make while rooted cuts it short.

text: Standing still increases aura radius, in full after 3s. +5% to +50% over 10 levels.
godot: Hold still and the sound carries. Your reach grows the longer you stay put, and resets the moment you move.

text: Ground enemies drift toward you. 10% to 100% strength over 10 levels.
godot: Look over there. Ground mice wander toward you instead of away - the crowd the Magician gave up its kittens to gather.

text: Each kill this wave increases Catnip per kill, up to 100 kills. +0.2% to +2% per kill.
godot: Every job needs a buyer. Catnip climbs with each kill this wave and starts over when the wave turns.

text: Increases crit damage for each halving of attack speed. +20% to +200% over 10 levels.
godot: The slower the swing, the worse it lands. Crit damage rises with everything that has made you slow.

text: Escaped enemies still give Catnip. 5% to 50% of it over 10 levels.
godot: Nothing leaves with its pockets full. Mice that wander off still pay you a share on the way out.

text: Standing still banks Catnip, in full after 10s. Your next kill adds 0.5 to 5 kills' worth.
godot: Stand around long enough and it adds up. The bank empties into your next kill.

text: Every 100th kill gives x20 to x200 Catnip over 10 levels.
godot: Everyone pays eventually. Every hundredth kill settles up in a lump.

text: Each kill increases spawn rate by 10% to 100%, up to +200%. It fades by 35% per second.
godot: Word gets around. Every kill brings more of them, and the rush fades if you stop.

text: An enemy vanishes every 20s to 6s over 10 levels. Bosses never vanish.
godot: Nothing up your sleeve. Every so often one of them is simply not there any more - bosses excepted.

text: Some paw attacks hit twice. 5% to 50% of attacks over 10 levels.
godot: Some swings land twice. No warning, no wind-up - the second one is simply already there.

text: During the Pounce lock, the ground under you burns. 20% to 200% of your damage.
godot: You do not land, you arrive. The ground you are rooted to burns for as long as you are stuck on it.
note: Lasts as long as the Pounce lock; your whole damage (damage zone).

text: A second aura trails 1s behind you. 10% to 100% of your damage over 10 levels.
godot: The sound gets there a moment after you do. A second, weaker ring keeps working where you just were.
note: Damage zones are priced on your whole damage, not the aura (tier_controller.gd _resolve_damage_zones).

text: After a crit, the next paw attack can kill instantly. 5% to 50% chance over 10 levels.
godot: A crit asks a question. Whatever the paw touches next does not get to answer it.

text: See part of the next hand while you choose. 1 to 3 cards over 3 levels.
godot: You have seen the plans. Part of the next hand is already known while you choose from this one.

text: Every 10th attack is a crit. Switching targets keeps the count.
godot: You find the beat and keep it. Every tenth swing crits without asking, and switching targets does not lose your place.

text: Every 6s, the aura deals 1s of its damage at once.
godot: The aura stops humming and starts pulsing. Everything inside takes the beat.

text: Marks where the next signature enemy will spawn.
godot: You know before they do. The next thing worth worrying about is marked where it will arrive.

text: Gain 1% of your Catnip every minute.
godot: Catnip you leave alone quietly grows, on the clock rather than on the kill.

text: Fliers near snared enemies move at 60% speed.
godot: The tangle spreads upward. Fliers that stray over the snared get dragged down into it - the only thing in the game that reaches them from the ground.

text: Paw attacks also hit up to 3 enemies behind the target.
godot: The swing does not stop at the first one. Whatever is lined up behind it gets the same blow - the aura you gave up, as a line.

text: +4% aura damage for each enemy inside the aura.
godot: You play to the room. The fuller the aura, the harder everything in it is hit.

text: Overkill gives extra Catnip: up to +100% of the kill's Catnip.
godot: Nothing is wasted. Damage that spilled past a kill comes back as Catnip.
note: Pays 50% of the kill's Catnip per 100% overkill, capped at 200% overkill.

text: Crits come on a fixed count, not at random. Same average.
godot: Crits stop being luck. The same chance is spent on a fixed cadence instead - no better on average, and never a cold streak again.

text: Enemies spawn in a ring 280px around you, not at the edges.
godot: They come to you now. Mice arrive in a ring around the cat instead of walking in from the edges.

text: A Pounce that kills nothing has no cooldown.
godot: Read the small print. A Pounce that rooted you and killed nothing costs no cooldown at all.

text: Kittens return, without damage. They pull enemies near them into your aura.
godot: The kittens come back, and they are not really there. They do no damage - they simply herd everything into your aura.

text: Wear a second job at 50% strength, upsides and downsides.
godot: Nobody said one job. Wear a second, at half its effect, good and bad alike.

text: Buy a boss's Bait with Catnip, at x3 its Catnip price.
godot: The bait was always a paperwork problem. Pay the boss's summons in Catnip and skip the grind entirely.

text: 1 card in every hand is 1 level higher.
godot: One card in every hand comes off the bench early, already a level ahead.

text: Increases spawn rate. x1.1 to x2.5 over 10 levels. Stacks with the Spawn Rate upgrade.
godot: Word gets out. They arrive far faster than the neighbourhood alone would send them - and this keeps climbing after the shop's Spawn Rate has nothing left to sell.

text: Travel to the next biome when it unlocks. You can turn it off in Realms.
godot: You stop waiting for permission. The moment the next biome opens you are already in it - and you can still switch it off if you want to linger.

text: Summons the boss as soon as you have its Bait. Never during a fight.
godot: The boss is summoned the instant you can afford it. Never mid-fight, and never without the Bait in hand.

text: Cards are picked for you without pausing. You can turn it off in Catches.
godot: A card is taken for you rather than stopping the game to ask. The pick screen only appears when you want it to.

text: Increases damage while 40 or more enemies are on screen. x1.05 to x1.6 over 10 levels.
godot: A full room is easier, not harder. Everything you do hits harder while forty or more of them are on the floor.

text: Increases damage while under 5 enemies are on screen. x1.2 to x3 over 10 levels.
godot: And an empty one is personal. With fewer than five left you hit vastly harder - which is the exact opposite of Swarm Logic, and there is a gap in the middle where neither helps.

text: Overkill of 10 times an enemy's health drops a Catnip bomb.
godot: Some kills are excessive. Overshoot a mouse by ten times its own health and the leftovers go off where it stood.

text: +0.5% to +5% damage per wave in this biome. Resets when you travel.
godot: They start to know your name. Damage climbs with every wave you survive here, and travelling loses all of it.

text: +1% to +10% damage per card taken this run. Resets when you Reawaken.
godot: You are keeping score. Every card taken this run makes you harder, and a Reawaken settles the account.
note: The name still needs your pick (no grudges).

text: +1% to +10% damage per 10,000 kills this run. Resets when you Reawaken.
godot: The number speaks for itself. Every ten thousand kills this cycle is another permanent notch until you Reawaken.

text: Kittens attack where enemies are densest, not the nearest enemy.
godot: Somebody organised them. Kittens go where the mice are thickest instead of grabbing whatever is nearest.

text: Each level up gives rerolls. +1 to +5 over 5 levels.
godot: You get another look. Every Catches level hands you rerolls to spend on the hands that follow.

text: Kittens get part of your crit chance. 10% to 100% over 10 levels.
godot: The kittens have been watching. They inherit a share of your crit chance - the first thing in the game that makes them scale with the paw.

text: +1 card in every hand.
godot: One more card in every hand, for good. More things to choose between, permanently - not more of any one thing.

text: Reawaken gives half its Stardust now. The other half comes when you reach City Rooftops.
godot: Reawakening pays out twice. Once when you do it, and once more the next time you reach the Park - so the second half is a reason to go back out.
note: Godot's text says 'the Park' (biome 3); the code pays on reaching biome 4, City Rooftops (game_state.gd begin_biome, arrived >= 3, 0-based). Finding F44.

text: The Realms tab shows each biome's Catnip reward.
godot: You have been reading ahead. The realm list says what a biome pays before you go there.

text: Bait earned in one biome counts in every biome.
godot: Bait stops being stranded. What you earned anywhere counts everywhere.
